REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - MARCH 10, 2026 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are
available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City
Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item
on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Economic Development Commission after
distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community
Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Regular Meeting Minutes of February 10, 2026
6.
New and Old Business
6A.
Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the Los Angeles County Economic Development Corporation's (LAEDC) 2026 Economic Forecast Report.
Agenda Report
Exhibit 1
6B.
Review and consideration of an informational report related to commercial filming in the City of Cerritos.
Agenda Report
7.
Reports
7A.
Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
7B.
Reports from Economic Development Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
8.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Economic Development Commission Meeting
March 10, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Kenneth Chiang
  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

PRESENT:  Director of Community Development Sabrina Chan
  Theater Executive Director Jeff Thielke
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade
  Management Analyst Mariel Angeles

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Reyes.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Economic Development Commission were declared present
  except Commissioner Hews, who was noted absent and excused by a majority
  consensus of the Economic Development Commission.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Economic
  Development Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda reported that one (1) written public
  comment was received under Agenda Item 4A. The comment was provided to the
  Commission.

5.  Consent Calendar

  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, February 10, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development Commission Regular
  Meeting Minutes.

City of Cerritos  March 10, 2026
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Hu, and seconded by Commissioner Tagle, to
  approve the Tuesday, February 10, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hews
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  New and Old Business

6A.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the Los Angeles
  County Economic Development Corporation’s (LAEDC) 2026 Economic Forecast
  Report.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed outlining highlights from the LAEDC Economic
  Forecast Report and summit conference. Ms. Miranda provided an overview of the
  national and state economic outlook, economic conditions within Los Angeles County,
  and key sector trends.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding key takeaways from the LAEDC
  Economic Forecast Report and Summit that could be applicable to the City of
  Cerritos, resources and efforts by the City to support businesses during slower
  economic periods, and housing in the City. The Economic Development Commission
  received and filed the report.

6B.  Review and consideration of an informational report related to commercial
  filming in the City of Cerritos.

  A staff report was given by Management Analyst Mariel Angeles. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed providing an overview of filming activities within the
  City of Cerritos, including the film permit application and review process.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding revenue generated from film
  permits, opportunities to further brand the City of Cerritos as a destination city, the
  potential economic benefits of filming activities in Cerritos, and efforts to diversify
  the City’s economic development initiatives. The Economic Development Commission
  received and filed the report.

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda reported that one (1) written public
  comment was received under Agenda Item 6B. The comment was provided to the
  Commission.

City of Cerritos  March 10, 2026
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
 7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Economic
  Development Commission.

7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Tagle and Chair Reyes.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:03 p.m.

  Kiana Miranda
  Kiana Miranda
  Secretary

s/s Alfred Reyes Jr.
